entities.name: Query protein (412 aa)
observations: Sequence matches a reviewed prokaryotic cysteine/cysteine-sulfinic-acid decarboxylase at 53.8% identity over 84.0% of query; annotation supports cysteine decarboxylation to cysteamine and cysteine-sulfinic-acid decarboxylation to hypotaurine.

Sequence matches reviewed bacterial CoaBC proteins at 41.5–45.6% identity over 93.9–94.9% of query; these homologs catalyze two steps in coenzyme A biosynthesis: phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligation and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation.

Localization is unresolved from the sequence annotation output; prokaryotic homolog annotations include a phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase complex cellular-component term, but this does not establish a specific cellular location for the query.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed bacterial CoaBC homologs are annotated to sequential CoA biosynthetic steps 2/5 and 3/5 from (R)-pantothenate; transfer to query is homology-based.
